Name: Capability
Description__c: Ability of people to perform the work successfully.

Name: Certification
Description__c: Formal certifications or validated qualifications.

Name: Training
Description__c: Training completed, required, assigned, or consumed.

Name: Expertise
Description__c: Specialized knowledge or experience relevant to the customer interaction.

Name: Role
Description__c: Functional role of the person serving or interacting with the customer.

Name: Authority
Description__c: Seniority or decision authority available in the relationship.

Name: Tenure
Description__c: Length of time a person has been in role or relationship.
Signal_Patterns__c: tenure, start date, years in role

Name: Continuity
Description__c: Stability of assigned people over time.

Name: Capacity
Description__c: Availability or workload of people serving the customer.

Name: Ownership
Description__c: Who owns the customer, case, opportunity, project, or activity.

Name: People Handoffs
Description__c: Transitions between people or teams serving the customer.

Name: Engagement
Description__c: Frequency and recency of human interaction with the customer.
Signal_Patterns__c: meeting, email, call, touch, activity, engagement

Name: Relationship Coverage
Description__c: Breadth and depth of people involved in the customer relationship.

Name: Effort
Description__c: Amount of work or number of interactions required to complete something.

Name: Friction
Description__c: Obstacles, blockers, failures, or complications in a process.

Name: Steps
Description__c: Number or sequence of steps required.

Name: Process Handoffs
Description__c: Transitions between teams, states, systems, or owners.

Name: Exceptions
Description__c: Deviations from the normal path.

Name: Escalation
Description__c: Movement into an escalated or higher-attention path.

Name: Rework
Description__c: Repeated, reopened, or backward-moving work.

Name: Process Clarity
Description__c: Evidence that steps and expectations are clear and understandable.
Signal_Patterns__c: clarity, instruction, defined, expected, next step

Name: Completion
Description__c: Successful completion of a process or milestone.

Name: Compliance
Description__c: Adherence to required process or service commitments.

Name: Abandonment
Description__c: Processes started but not completed.

Name: First-Time-Right
Description__c: Completion without rework, repeat contact, or correction.
Signal_Patterns__c: first contact, first time, no reopen, no rework

Name: Speed
Description__c: How quickly work progresses.

Name: Response Time
Description__c: Time until a first or subsequent response.

Name: Wait Time
Description__c: Time the customer waits between process events.

Name: Duration
Description__c: Elapsed time from start to completion.
Signal_Patterns__c: duration, time to resolution, age days, ageing, cycle time

Name: Recency
Description__c: Time since the most recent relevant event.
Signal_Patterns__c: last, recent, activity date, login date

Name: Predictability
Description__c: Consistency of timing or ability to meet expected dates.
Signal_Patterns__c: predictable, due date, estimated close, forecast

Name: Lateness
Description__c: Whether actual timing exceeds commitments or due dates.

Name: Time Variability
Description__c: Dispersion or inconsistency in elapsed times.

Name: Accuracy
Description__c: Correctness of information provided.

Name: Information Clarity
Description__c: Ease of understanding communications or guidance.

Name: Completeness
Description__c: Whether required information is present.

Name: Consistency
Description__c: Consistency of information across interactions or systems.

Name: Availability
Description__c: Whether useful information is available when needed.

Name: Communication
Description__c: Frequency, channel, and responsiveness of communications.

Name: Guidance
Description__c: Help, instruction, recommendations, or direction provided.

Name: Documentation
Description__c: Use and quality of documents, knowledge, or written artifacts.

Name: Usage
Description__c: Observed use of the product or service.

Name: Adoption
Description__c: Breadth/depth of capabilities adopted.

Name: Reliability
Description__c: Stability and successful operation.

Name: Defects
Description__c: Product defects or bugs experienced.

Name: Quality
Description__c: Overall service/product quality signals.

Name: Usability
Description__c: Ease of using the product or service.

Name: Functionality
Description__c: Capabilities/features available and used.

Name: Integration
Description__c: Quality and health of integrations.

Name: Performance
Description__c: Operational product/service performance.

Name: Outcomes
Description__c: Business or customer outcomes achieved.

Name: Value Realization
Description__c: Evidence that expected value is being achieved.

Name: ROI
Description__c: Return relative to cost or investment.

Name: Adoption Benefit
Description__c: Benefit associated with actual adoption/use.

Name: Commercial Growth
Description__c: Growth in commercial relationship.

Name: Renewal
Description__c: Renewal exposure, likelihood, and completion.

Name: Expansion
Description__c: Expansion or upsell potential/realization.

Name: Relationship Durability
Description__c: Length and persistence of the customer relationship.
